title: 'The Paymaster's Errand' hint says to read the ford's line 'west of the mill-race,' but the actual Ford is roughly eight river-bank rooms further out (Millgate, Boundary Meadow, Towpath, Drowned Quay, Rushy Corner, Willow Holt, Slack Water, Ferry Cut, then one more north) — a much longer walk than 'west of the mill-race' suggests, with no distance given the way other hints (e.g. Fenmarch's 'two stands west, then in') provide.
where: The Paymaster's Chest-Room quest text; the Pennywell river-bank rooms between Millgate and The Ford
